Our client operates in the logistics sector, specializing in warehouse operations and inventory management. The company focuses on the efficient handling, storage and distribution of goods. Quality, accuracy and safety are essential in its daily operations. Employees work together to ensure smooth inbound and outbound processes. You will join a professional warehouse environment where teamwork and efficiency are key.
Jobomschrijving

Looking for an opportunity where you can make a visible impact and help shape a growing operation from the ground up? Our client Segex is a new and expanding logistics organization based in Wommelgem, specializing in the storage, packaging, and distribution of healthcare and pharmaceutical products.

As part of an international group this company manages the flow of products from global manufacturers to customers across Central- and South- America, Europe and Asia. The Belgian operation was launched recently and currently employs a small team of around eight people, creating a unique opportunity to join a business in an exciting growth phase.

As Warehouse Supervisor, you will take ownership of the day-to-day warehouse operations and lead the Belgian warehouse team. You will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence while helping build processes and structure within a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate the warehouse team, ensuring smooth daily operations.
• Manage inbound, outbound, picking, packing, inventory, and stock accuracy activities.
• Monitor warehouse KPIs and identify opportunities for operational improvement.
• Act as the local key user for the Warehouse Management System (WMS).
• Coordinate staffing, holidays, absences, and workforce planning in collaboration with local management.
• Ensure compliance with quality, safety, and operational procedures.
• Work closely with the international operations team in headquarters and support the continued growth of the Belgian site.

You enjoy being present on the warehouse floor, taking ownership, and motivating people to achieve operational goals.

Who You Are?

• A natural team leader who leads by example and communicates clearly.
• Structured, hands-on, and solution-oriented.
• Comfortable working in a dynamic international logistics environment.
• Focused on quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.
• Proactive and capable of making operational decisions independently.
must haves

• Minimum 3 years of experience within warehouse or logistics operations.
• Proven experience as a Warehouse Supervisor, Team Leader, or Warehouse Coordinator.
• Experience managing and motivating operational teams.
• Strong understanding of inbound, outbound, inventory management, and warehouse KPIs.
• Hands-on experience with a Warehouse Management System (WMS).
• Good knowledge of international logistics and imported goods flows.
• Professional proficiency in English and Spanish. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a strong asset

• You’re skilled in photography, videography, and editing tools. 

• You understand social media trends and know how to adapt them to a luxury brand voice. 

•  You have experience managing social media, newsletters, and website content. 

• You’re proactive, detail-oriented, and full of ideas. 

• You’re fluent in Dutch, French, and English. 

• You understand influencer marketing and community building. 

• You have a deep passion for beauty, design, and lifestyle experiences.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Representative Travel Europe | Hoogstraten | vast contract
jobs.description:
For our client in Hoogstraten, we are looking for a Customer Service Representative Travel Europe with immediate permanent employment.

As Customer Service Representative, you are the main point of contact for the customers when it comes to orders, production process follow up, deliveries and introduction of new products. Together with the team of colleagues in the Belgian office and worldwide you ensure the highest level of satisfaction and are able to provide a solution to any problem, either commercial or logistical.

Main Responsibilties: 

 
• End-to-end customer service: from order intake to delivery and aftersales follow-up 
 
• Processing and monitoring sales orders (order entry, production follow-up, delivery tracking) 
 
• Handling complaints and finding solutions in close cooperation with sales 
 
• Daily coordination with internal departments and international stakeholders 
 
• Forecasting, demand management and stock monitoring 
 
• Supporting the sales team with commercial and operational tasks 
 
• Ensuring excellent customer satisfaction at all timesTypical day: 
 
• Morning: order entry and administrative processing 
 
• Afternoon: customer follow-up and complaint handling 

 

• Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience 

• Minimum of 2 years' commercial experience in an international B-to B market environment 

• Experience with ERP systems and Microsoft Office Suite 

• Knowledge of logistics, INCO terms and customs procedures is preferred 

• Positive mindset, desire to learn and improve yourself as well as existing processes, attention to detail and problem solving 

• Proficient in English and Dutch both oral and written, German or Spanish are an advantage

JOIN THE TEAM THAT’S POWERING PROGRESS 

 

Building cities. Driving commerce. Fueling Progress. For over 100 years, Allison has powered the vehicles and technology that move our world forward.  What powers us? Our employees. From the first person hired by James Allison in 1915 to the thousands across the globe who work for Allison today, we’re driving progress everywhere because we employ top talent worldwide. In both the Allison Transmission and Allison Off-Highway Drive and Motion Systems business units, our team strives to Improve the Way the World Works.   

 

Learn more about this role and how you can begin driving your career forward! 

Primary Purpose of Role: Teamlead Design & Drafting

The Team Lead Design & Drafting leads the Design and Drafting team and is responsible for delivering high-quality engineering design solutions and lifecycle management of drivetrain and gearbox products. The role ensures that product designs meet requirements related to quality, reliability, manufacturability, sustainability and cost efficiency, while supporting the successful execution of new product development projects and engineering changes.

 

Key Responsibilities

·        Lead, coach and develop the Design and Drafting team.

·        Drive employee engagement, performance management and talent development.

·        Ensure high-quality and timely delivery of design activities for new product development projects.

·        Oversee engineering changes, product documentation and bill of material governance.

·        Monitor team workload, resource planning and operational KPIs.

·        Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, quality and project stakeholders.

·        Drive continuous improvement, standardization and automation initiatives.

·        Support design reviews and ensure adherence to engineering standards and processes.

·        Maintain service parts lists and support the complete product lifecycle.

 

Scope Factors

·        Direct leadership of 4 employees in Brugge and indirect coordination of 8 employees in India.

·        Responsibility for engineering activities supporting projects with an annual value of approximately EUR 2 to 3 million.

·        Department budget responsibility of approximately EUR 0.5 million.

·        Oversight of approximately 1,000 design changes annually.

·        Management of approximately 500 service parts list updates per year.

·        Support of 1 to 2 new product development projects annually.

Competencies and Behaviors

·        Strong leadership and coaching capabilities.

·        Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

·        Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.

·        Ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple activities simultaneously.

·        Results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

·        Organized and detail-oriented approach to work.

·        Collaborative team player with a customer-focused mindset.

·        Ability to work independently and make informed decisions.

 

Qualifications and Experience

·        Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent through experience.

·        Minimum 10 years of experience in gearbox design, drivetrain systems or a similar engineering environment.

·        Proven experience with CAD software, preferably PTC Creo.

·        Good understanding of manufacturing, assembly, quality and service operations.

·        Experience working with PLM and workflow systems such as Teamcenter.

·        Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

·        Fluent in English.

·        Good command of Dutch is an advantage; willingness to learn Dutch is required

jobs.occupation: Start as a C Driver and grow into CE
jobs.description:
Job description 
As a C driver at our company, you will start by transporting construction materials and machinery. This is done using different types of trucks, such as box trucks and crane trucks. You will not always be required to load and unload the cargo yourself, but occasionally your assistance may be needed. Do you have experience with a loading crane? That’s a plus! But don’t worry if you don’t, as you will receive internal training. If you already hold a C driving license, you also have the opportunity to progress to CE. This is your chance to further develop your career in the transport sector! What are you waiting for? Join our team and give your career a boost!

 Requirements 
  Start as a C Driver and Grow into CE Have you ever dreamed of hitting the road while taking your career to the next level? Then this is your chance! Start as a C driver and explore the opportunities to grow into a CE driver. Language skills In this role, it is important to have a good command of Dutch, French, and/or English. This not only helps in communication with customers but also broadens your opportunities in an increasingly international environment. Motivation to learn crane work We also offer you the opportunity to learn crane operation. Why let this chance pass you by? These additional skills increase your value on the job market and make you indispensable for future employers. It is not only an investment in your career, but also in your personal development. Why wait? Seize this opportunity to build a successful career as a driver. Now is the perfect time to take the step toward a challenging and rewarding future full of growth and new experiences. Take that first step today!
